prompts.tambor:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: transparent 16-bit pixel-art animated combat VFX spritesheet for Torii & Hutukara, 3/4 top-down 2D RPG. Input images are STYLE/MATERIAL references ONLY: existing boss pulse and static FX. Match their rough clustered pixel matter, broken edges, ivory highlights and restrained smoke, scaled down for ordinary enemies. Create real physical movement, NOT a sequence of icons. No characters, bodies, instruments, equipment, notes, runes, logos, badges, closed circles, UI, labels, borders, gridlines, backgrounds, floor shadows or rectangular glow plates. Genuine RGBA transparency. Sparse open effects with visible empty space inside the effect, no heavy outline. Every frame entirely isolated with at least 20% transparent margin on all four sides. Fixed central pivot and identical scale across frames: do not center each phase by its changing bounding box. Temporal sequence has eight distinct authored shapes: frames1–2 small gathering motion;3 acceleration;4–5 brief broken expansion/contact peak;6 breakup;7 sparse trailing fragments;8 almost dissipated. Nothing touches or crosses into another frame.
Layout landscape2:1, exactly4 columns and2 rows, eight equal square cells read left-to-right then next row. One clip: amber/ivory acoustic compression wave traveling RIGHT. First gather a short ragged pressure crease, then thrust forward as 2–3 BROKEN uneven arcs widening into a cone with copper dust torn outward; peak briefly buckles and breaks, then sparse fragments drift right. No drum or circular ring. Texture like pulse reference with warm amber copper, huge transparent gaps.
